timing: Added after observing primary results, before computing this pooled model. Original protocol and all original results retained.
reason: Original joint section/hand/position/source-end tables cannot learn neighbor effects for styles absent from training. In particular some withheld quires have exactly zero gain by construction.
new_model: Use the original positional baseline, multiply each target probability by P(target|source_end)/P_global(target), then normalize. Both global distributions learned only on training folds, with symmetric 0.5 global pseudocount and source-end backoff strength 32. This pools a common edge correction across style and position contexts.
assumption: Source-end log-probability correction is shared across contexts. Model comparison tests this assumption; no language or cryptographic interpretation follows.
fixed_settings: Same folds, cohorts, representations, alpha sensitivities, 199 within-page/position permutations and 2000 fixed-score cluster resamples as original. No outcome-based tuning or replacement of original results.
toy_controls: Two deterministic-seed eight-block synthetic corpora, each 80 lines x 10 three-letter tokens per block and a unique style per block. Ends uniform over a,b,c,d. Positive control next initial equals preceding final; negative control initial independent uniform. Fixed before generation. Both original and pooled models evaluated, with 199 conditional permutations for the pooled model.
interpretation: An exploratory methodological repair. Any positive finding requires external replication, including alternative position measurement and models.
